d: Diwali 2026 : rajdhani patna samet pure bihar men ravivar ko dipon ka mahaparv dipavli harshollas aur umang ke sath manaya ja raha hai... rajy men dipavli ki dhum hai... parv ko lekar shanivar ko pure din bajaron men raunak chhaee rahi... subah se der sham tak kharidaron ki bhir umarti rahi... logon ne lakshmi-ganesh ki pratimaon, mitti ke diye, mombattiyon, phul-malaon, pujan samagri aur mithaiyon ki jamkar kharidari ki... rajdhani ke pramukh bajaron se lekar jila mukhyalyon aur kasbaee bajaron tak chahal-pahal bani rahi
